review: T. Corp Outis is a Tremor-centric Identity who doesn't feel like a Season 6 identity due to her skill rolls and reliance on being in “Borrowed Time” state. Without being in “Borrowed Time” state, Outis’s skills will roll less than the majority of the Identities released before her. So let's look at her skills without factoring “Borrowed Time” status for now. - Skill 1 - Prepare to Collect - 2 Coins - Base roll 11 - Max roll 13 - Decent Tremor Count gain and infliction as far as skill 1 goes, but max roll leaves a bit to be desired. - Skill 2 - T Corp. Microcavity Module - 3 Coins - Base roll 18 - Max roll 21 - Decent Tremor application and gain while also triggering Amplitude Conversion into Tremor - Chain, which helps with Clashing. - Skill 3 - T-3 Collector Mace Max Activation - 3 Coins - Base roll 17 - Max roll 23 - This skill allows Outis to convert Borrowed Time to Violent Collectio
